relationships.subject: TREK1
relationships.evidence_quote: Downregulation of TREK1 or TREK2 expression may result in increased sensitivity to mechanical and thermal pain.

key_findings: In high-energy-diet prediabetic rats, Sortilin is upregulated in DRG neurons, binds TREK1/TREK2 and reduces their expression, decreasing TREK1/2 currents and causing DRG hyperexcitability and pain hypersensitivity.
Sortilin knockdown or the TREK1/2 opener BL1249 in the DRG alleviated prediabetic neuropathic pain, while Sortilin overexpression or Spadin induced hypersensitivity.
